description:
Required Experience 
• Strong IBM WebSphere Portal version 8 , Forms Experience Builder (FEB) v8, Connections v5 , WebSphere Content Management( WCM ), Connection Content Management (CCM) , WebSphere Application Server(WAS) administration skills
• Experience with XML access, WCM Syndication and Portal Deployment best practices 
• Experience with installing and configuring Portlets
• Ability to plan Portal installation ,upgrade and cumulative fix and produce written documentation (procedures and work instructions) 
• Experience with version control(MKS integrity, PTC Integrity, Subversion/SVN)
• Experience in RHEL(Red Hat Enterprise Linux)
• Experience Designing and Implementing IBM WebSphere Portal Security with Single Sign-on and LDAP 
• Experience working with IBM Tech Support 
• Strong problem resolution and debugging skills related to IBM WebSphere Portal and components
• Familiarity with systems/process integration, web services architecture, network architecture, network security and databases
• Knowledge of IBM WebSphere Portal data model and table structures to help design scripts to automate WebSphere Portal and Web Content Management( WCM )Workflow
• Outstanding ability to listen and really 'hear' the customer
• Good communication, interpersonal skills backed by sound analytical, technical and leadership skills.

 Preferred Experience 
• Experience with building portlets and pages on WebSphere Portal Server 8 including WebSphere Portlet Factory (using Eclipse), Portlet API (JSR 168) and Portal Development Toolkit and RAD (Rational Application Developer).
• Experience in developing functionalities using Forms Experience Builder (FEB) 
• Experience in designing and developing pages using Web Content Management(WCM) , Connection Content Management (CCM), Forums and Blogs
• Experience in developing and deploying J2EE applications on WAS using WAS admin console and scripting tool.
• Integrate and implement Portlets using Web services
• Experience with HTML5, CSS, Javascript and jQuery and json
• Experience in web based/server side applications using J2EE Technologies (Java, Swing, JDBC, JSP, Servlets, EJB, XML, DOM/SAX, Struts, Spring and Web Services
• Knowledge of Microstrategy SDK

 General Experience: 14 or more years of related IT experience, 5 or more years of Portal experience
 Education: Bachelor of Science in related field or equivalent years of experience



 If you are interested in the below position please forward your profile to  mohammedm@usmsystems(dot)com or call me on 703-880-2641
